Create a fresh scratch org and substitute its administrator username for SCRATCH_ADMIN_USERNAME in the populated provider metadata files. Deploy two synthetic custom authentication plugins, their custom metadata types and records, two Custom providers and one Salesforce-managed provider. Plugin methods return null and are never invoked; no authentication requests or callouts are made. Through the data API at 62.0 and 67.0, query all three providers and require one saved null PluginId and two different populated plugin IDs before recording the five ORDER BY variants.
